name: 4270-batchdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, bounded at 2560 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, fixed lengths: prompt exactly 128 tokens and output exactly 384 tokens, min = max on both. `request_format: plain`, `ignore_eos` set so every request emits exactly 384, sampling temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0. Written out in scenario.json.
purpose: A long-form answer generator on one GPU, serving 256 concurrent users short prompts and lengthy replies.
launch:
# The engine's command line. It is an April-2024 vLLM, whose `AsyncEngineArgs` raises a TypeError
# at engine construction on an unknown key -- do not add arguments from a later vLLM.
# Everything except `model`, `tensor-parallel-size` and `max-model-len` is the engine's own default
# at the pinned commit, written out so it cannot drift.

# `meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct` is gated, so the repo id below names the ungated
# re-upload of the same weights.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
# Before reading a number off a run, check the logged `# GPU blocks:` line: 256 streams x
# (128 + 384) tokens at this block size needs 8192 blocks, and an engine reporting fewer preempts.
block-size: 16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
enforce-eager: false
max-model-len: 2048
